name: Rapunzel's Warm Pretzel Bread Service
whyItWorks: Pillow-soft Bavarian pretzel rolls made from refined white flour and yeast digest effortlessly with near-zero roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the warm pretzel bread with plain butter (or smooth cheese dip) and skip the whole-grain mustard seed dip if flaring.
watchOuts: Whole mustard seeds in the mustard dip
Coarse salt crystals if mouth ulcers are present
